list.title: Caution
list.content: To see a noticeable difference in you, it is recommended that you use these Magnesium Gummies regularly and consistently for 3-4 months.  We suggest taking a doctor's consultation before incorporating it in your routine. These gummies won't cause any reactions, if it does, please stop using them and consult a doctor before adding them back to your routine.

list.title: If there is no sugar, how is it sweet?
list.content: The sweetness comes from prebiotic fibre called chicory root. It also has very low (near zero) glycemic index & causes no glucose spikes. Chicory also is good for gut.

list.title: Are there any artificial additives?
list.content: No. The base of this gummy is made of a prebiotic fibre called chicory root. The colour comes from black carrot extract & the flavour comes from mixed berry extract. There are no artificial fillers, preservatives added.

list.title: Can I use this Gummy every day?
list.content: Yes, we recommend using these gummies every day.

list.title: Are these gummies safe for everyone?
list.content: These gummies are generally safe for everyone to consume. But if you have a critical health condition, or if you are pregnant, then we recommend speaking to a healthcare professional.

list.title: Can Magnesium help with anxiety and stress?
list.content: Yes, Magnesium is an essential micronutrient, getting enough of which helps reduce stress and anxiety by balancing neurotransmitter levels and lowering stress hormones. Additionally, it also helps with muscle cramps/pain relief & aids in 300+ biochemical reactions in the body.

list.title: Are there any side effects of taking Magnesium?
list.content: Magnesium is generally well-tolerated when taken as directed. Our gummies combine five forms of magnesium with vitamins B6, D3, and B9 for optimal absorption and efficacy, while being free from added refined sugar. Adhering to the recommended serving ensures safe use. For individuals with specific health conditions or on medication, consulting a healthcare professional is advised.

list.title: Can I take Magnesium gummies along with other supplements, like Biotin?
list.content: Yes, you can. Magnesium also supports the function of other vitamins and minerals.

list.title: Are there any allergens in the product?
list.content: Check the specific product label for allergen information, but most Magnesium Glycinate products are formulated to be free from common allergens like natural gluten, dairy, or soy.

list.title: Do I need to take a blood test before taking Magnesium?
list.content: No, a blood test is generally unnecessary for adults who wish to take magnesium supplements at recommended doses unless symptoms or certain medical conditions suggest an imbalance.
